name: Nikhila Vimal
bio: Nikhila Vimal is an Indian actress who is active in Malayalam and Tamil  film industry. She made her acting debut in Television with a  documentary on Saint Alphonsa which aired on Shalom TV. While studying  in Std 8th, she made her big screen debut in the film Bhagyadevatha (2009) where she played Jayaram's sister in the film. She is well known to the Tamil audience as Latha from Vetrivel (2016) film, in which she was the pair of M. Sasikumar.
